Parker lane continued closure ! When will this end ? Why was it scheduled for when I 35 construction already causes traffic problems. ?Who is responsible ! ? Please update us !

New street obstructions prevent drivers from staying in their lane. Doesn't a double yellow line still mean something? Are you hoping to train Austin drivers to think a double yellow line is something to be ignored? Do you want drivers to drive safely and be safe? Or are you opposed to drivers? Or are you hoping they have more accidents?

the traffic light coming OUT of the woods of Westlake on Scottish woods trail frequently fails to recognize cars waiting.  this evening it missed me for 3 cycles.  its been awful and inconsistent for years.  please inspect and fix
Abandoned trailer on bend of road.  Safety issue!!!!!

Following the recent repaving, the asphalt around the manhole covers is severely sunken. It creates a deep, abrupt dip that causes cars to bottom out. Drivers are dangerously swerving around them to avoid vehicle damage. The depression around the metal structure needs to be filled in and leveled with the new road surface.

Loud amplified music and heavy bass from Cheer Up Charlies at 900 Red River St are continuing after the 10:30 PM Sunday cutoff for outdoor amplified sound. The music is clearly audible inside my nearby hotel room, even with the windows closed, and is interfering with my ability to sleep. Please investigate whether the venue is operating amplified outdoor sound beyond its permitted hours.

Illegal DJ Pop Up Club with base in Abandoned Unpermitted Lot between old Con Vista Del Mar restaurant and Green Grocery on E 7th. Party has someone on alley side checking people in. Relatively built out set up and lights. Please investigate asap.

Noise Complaint

I would like to submit a noise complaint regarding Coquito. They have been playing amplified outdoor music without a sound permit and continuing to play music late into the night. The amplified music is disruptive to surrounding businesses and residents. Please look into this matter and verify whether they are operating in compliance with the City’s sound ordinance and permit requ

The people at 8515 Palace Parkway let their dog bark every single night, usually between 4am and 6am, for 30-45 minutes. Neighbors have talked to them about it and it is clear they do not care. The city needs to take action on this as it has been going on for a year. I can submit videos of the dog barking if needed.

These 2 dogs have been without shelter, food, or water since 8/25 and have become increasingly thin, dirty, and with untreated scabs, scrapes & skin issues. They have also started stopping in the middle of the street to scratch often. They are scared but sweet & accept water & cheese. Owners have not been home for at least 5 days. This isn’t the first time these dogs have been left to the elements

Small pet tied to this car’s side-view mirror. No visible food, water, or proper shelter. Animal is lying on pavement in approximately 100°F heat. Concerned for the animal’s safety and possible heat-related distress. Requesting an immediate welfare check. The person may be living out of their car but cannot confirm this. Located in UPS parking lot at corner of E Oltorf and South Congress.

This fence blew over Thursday and is completely blocking the sidewalk. This owner needs to better manage this property, it’s a complete mess. This fence already blocks street site (making turns from Johanna on to first) and now you have to walk on to south first to get around it.

Non-resident, non-paying, gold pontiac sedan parked in a RPP/pay area.  The signage is attached as a reference because I keep getting responses that are closed saying that it’s not RPP hours.  Just because it’s not RPP hours doesn’t mean people can park there without paying.  They still have to pay to park.

The signal timing at the intersection is substantially different than it used to be at the intersection of Anderson Mill Rd and FM620.  The cycle time for NB FM620 is really short, causing queuing during non-peak times.  These queues are approximately a mile long and are causing substantial delays.  This signal was out of service earlier this week because of the storms, so maybe that caused the is

The traffic light have been flashing for over 12 hours. This is a major intersection and traffic gets backed up already. Now this is causing even more backup. This intersection does this anytime there are heavy rains, can we strengthen this intersection to avoid this repetitive issue at this particular location please.

A tree in the posted City of Austin stormwater drainage facility behind 6513 Alum Rock Cv (lot 4) broke during strong winds. The tree is 15+ ft from my fence and touching the fence at 8408 Fall Meadow Ln (lot 3), near public utility/drainage easements. Please have Watershed Protection determine if the tree is within the City-managed facility/easement and who is responsible for removal. Photos of t

There appears to be some sort of homeless camp under the bridge on 51st street at Waller Creek.  I can’t get a good look but it seems to be pretty much blocking the creek.  Beyond that there is just ridiculous amounts of trash all up and down the creek especially towards North Loop.  I wish there was a way to better control access for people getting back there.  Like a short fence at the bridges.

Marshaling Yard I’ve been told that there is a dog in active labor at the marshaling yard for homeless and the weekend staff can’t handle it so they’re gonna ask the homeless person to remove the dog from their facility and deal with it. This person is ill equipped to deal with a dog in active labor, who also has worms. I need somebody to go. Make sure that that dog is taken care of.
Victory Lap and Bungalow - music WAY ABOVE legal volume.  95dBA right now.   I am convinced the APD officers are paid off as they do not investigate or give citations.   Awful experience.

I put in a request last week to have a large pothole filled and I was informed the work order was completed but when I went to follow up and take a look I saw that the pothole was only partially filled in. Is it possible for the city of Austin to fill and even out that shoulder area so cars can safely pull off the road when we are responding to emergency calls?

Rooster sighted at the Southeast Branch of the Austin Public Library around 10:50AM. It was on the lawn between the fire station and the library. It looked healthy. I’ve never seen it there before so unsure if it flew away from someone’s home or was dropped off there or Dove Springs Park.

I am reporting an urgent animal-welfare concern at Austin Animal Center, 7201 Levander Loop. The facility has reportedly been without functioning air conditioning for approximately two weeks during extreme Austin heat, with reports of indoor temperatures exceeding 100°F. I am requesting an immediate Animal Protection/welfare assessment and escalation to the appropriate City department. I also want
3 dead animals. All on access road of south bound 35 access road. All 3 animals in close proximity to one another. Dog, cat , possum. Who do I contact if you are now not picking up in this area?

there's a delivery truck parked at the intersection of 3rd and Walter c home and it is at the intersection but with its flashes on and nobody in it, it is completely blocking traffic and needs to be moved immediately
Twins Nightclub continues to blare music at all hours. This needs to be addressed immediately. I have been reporting this for months and it is never addressed. Does this city do anything?

Inn Cahoots Outdoor Noise Violation - we know they have an outdoor music permit. We also know there are requirements for them to maintain under the outdoor music commercial venue permit threshold. They consistently (every single weekend) blast base far exceeding the permitted allowance. It is a huge disrespect to an entire neighborhood of people trying to live. They should not be able to consisten

Pitbull mix and a jack Russel mix I do not have pictures of the other dog, but there is a black-white and gray husky that runs around with them that is also wreaking havoc on the neighborhood the pitbull is somewhat aggressive and very territorial people just walking, exercising or walking their dogs. Do not come this way anymore the dogs are pulling trash out a trash cans and just roaming around

Two dogs, Champ and Wisdom, roaming, barking aggressively at pets and people. Have charged at people and pets many times in the past. They belong to Olivia Neal of 5414 Walnut Grove Dr. She has an extensive history of not keeping her dogs on her own property.

Stray dogs and cats (brown pug, German shepherd, a pit with mottled coat & about 30 cats) are congregating at 3 retention ponds in Berdoll. One pond is at corner of Perconte and Lipton loop; the other at Thome valley and near Bahan & at end of Toye. The ponds are all kind of connected by a dry drainage ditch. The cats are at corner of Nijmegen and spiers & everywhere.

I’d like to report a noise complaint about a neighbor’s dog. The dog has been barking repeatedly after midnight and is disturbing my sleep. This is happening right now, at approximately 5:20 AM on August 25. I’d like to request that someone address the ongoing noise disturbance.

Large accumulation of trash, cardboard boxes, packaging debris, plastic wrap, and litter covering the front yard of this residence, visible from the street. Items include broken furniture, tarps, empty beer bottles/cans, and what appear to be disassembled tent/canopy poles. Requesting a code compliance officer inspect and issue notice to the property owner.

Premium Parking, a private non-CoA affiliated company,  has placed signs and is charging people for street parking on public streets in the Highland Neighborhood. These signs are everywhere - Clayton Lane, Highland Campus Drive, Jacob Fontaine Lane, Denson Road. They are ticketing people.

I live at 301 E 4th street and when trying to pull up to our dumpster to access through the alley  to unload I was unable to because the entire alley is blocked by vehicles. It looks like the alley is blocked up on both sides
Left turn too short William cannon and 290 westbound the left signal needs to start when westbound traffic gets green light. No other traffic is moving and it’s safe for both at the same time.

Homeless camping in park/playground area. 

I couldn’t get close enough, but there were two underneath the Kids play ground shooting up. You could see them clearly hunched over with needles.
